title: Ryan Gosling set to join Marvel Cinematic Universe as Ghost Rider
facts: Marvel Studios announced that Ryan Gosling will play Ghost Rider in the Marvel Cinematic Universe in 2028.
Marvel Studios President Kevin Feige revealed the Ghost Rider casting at San Diego Comic-Con.
Film critic Josh Horowitz questioned Kevin Feige about Ghost Rider casting during Comic-Con.
Shawn Levy is set to direct the Marvel Cinematic Universe's Ghost Rider project.
Shawn Levy directed Ryan Gosling in the film 'Star Wars: Starfighter'.
Ryan Gosling and Shawn Levy discussed ideas for Ghost Rider while filming 'Star Wars: Starfighter'.
The Ghost Rider character first appeared in Marvel comics in 1967 as Western hero Carter Slade.
The Johnny Blaze version of Ghost Rider debuted in Marvel Spotlight issue 5 in 1972.
In Marvel comics lore, Johnny Blaze transforms into a flaming skull after making a pact with Satan.
Nicolas Cage portrayed Ghost Rider in a feature film released in 2007.
Eva Mendes co-starred alongside Nicolas Cage in the 2007 film 'Ghost Rider'.
Nicolas Cage reprised his role as Ghost Rider in a sequel film released in 2011.
Ryan Gosling is a Golden Globe-winning actor.
The Ghost Rider announcement was made during the 2026 San Diego Comic-Con convention.
Ghost Rider is depicted in Marvel comics as a supernatural motorcyclist clad in leather.
